topics: Binomial expansion for positive integer n

body.en: Deep factorisation of higher-degree polynomials without trial-and-error graphing, paired with the powerful Binomial Theorem for expanding \( (a+b)^n \) algebraically.

If a polynomial \( P(x) \) is divided by \( (ax - b) \), the remainder is \( R = P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right) \).
If \( P\left(\frac{b}{a}\right) = 0 \), then \( (ax - b) \) is an exact factor of \( P(x) \).

label.en: Worked Example 2.A — Unknown Coefficients via Remainder Theorem

body.en:
The polynomial \( P(x) = 2x^3 + ax^2 + bx - 6 \) has \( (x - 2) \) as a factor. When divided by \( (x + 1) \), the remainder is \( 12 \). Find the values of \( a \) and \( b \).

Step 1: Use Factor Theorem:
\( P(2) = 0 \implies 2(2)^3 + a(2)^2 + b(2) - 6 = 0 \implies 16 + 4a + 2b - 6 = 0 \implies 4a + 2b = -10 \implies 2a + b = -5 \) (Equation 1).
Step 2: Use Remainder Theorem:
\( P(-1) = 12 \implies 2(-1)^3 + a(-1)^2 + b(-1) - 6 = 12 \implies -2 + a - b - 6 = 12 \implies a - b = 20 \) (Equation 2).
Step 3: Solve simultaneously:
Add (1) and (2): \( (2a + b) + (a - b) = -5 + 20 \implies 3a = 15 \implies a = 5 \).
Substitute \( a = 5 \) into (2): \( 5 - b = 20 \implies b = -15 \).
Answer: \( a = 5, \, b = -15 \).

label.en: Worked Example B — Algebraic Structure & Vieta's Root Relations
label.ar: مثال محلول B — البنية الجبرية وعلاقات الجذور

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ or } x = 6 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 3 + 6 = \mathbf{9} \) and product \( = (3)(6) = \mathbf{18} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ أو } x = 6 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{9} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{18} \).

question.en: [Polynomials, Remainder Theorem & Binomial Theorem · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Polynomials, Remainder Theorem & Binomial Theorem · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).
